title: Qualcomm stock slides after Q3 earnings top revenue expectations as smartphone market slows
excerpt: Qualcomm announced its Q3 earnings after the bell on Thursday.
content_html:
Chipmaker Qualcomm (QCOM) reported its third quarter results on Wednesday, meeting expectations on earnings per share, while topping revenue projections.

For the third quarter, Qualcomm saw earnings per share (EPS) of $2.21 on revenue of $9.9 billion. Analysts were anticipating EPS of $2.21 and revenue of $9.6 billion.

"Despite a challenging memory and supply environment, our third quarter results reflect solid execution of our growth strategy, with quarterly revenues at the high end of guidance," CEO Cristiano Amon said in a statement.

"In the near term, we expect year-over-year growth in non-handset revenues, including Data Center, to accelerate from 24% in fiscal 2026 to greater than 60% in fiscal 2027 — a significant inflection point in the execution of our growth strategy."

Shares in the technology stalwart sank almost 6% in premarket trading on Thursday as investors assessed the results.

Qualcomm is in the midst of a broad diversification effort as it works to reduce its dependence on its handset business, which has slowed over the years.

That's become increasingly important as smartphone makers increase prices to offset the rising cost of memory and storage chips, impacting shipments.

"The smartphone industry is not great," Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon told Yahoo Finance's Julie Hyman on Wednesday.

"Memory prices are going up, and AI is sort of sucking up a lot of the supply. And so it's just not leaving a lot for the smartphone players. And we're seeing unit growth has gone negative," he added.

According to CounterPoint Research, Q2 global smartphone shipments fell 11% year over year, marking the industry's worst second quarter in 13 years.

Qualcomm's CDMA Technologies segment revenue, which includes smartphone, internet of things, and automotive sales, came in at $8.5 billion versus expectations of $8.2 billion. 

Handset sales in particular topped $5.1 billion compared to an anticipated $4.9 billion. Automotive-related sales hit $1.5 billion; Wall Street was looking for $1.4 billion in the quarter.

Part of Qualcomm's plan to expand its total addressable market includes a sharp turn into the AI data center space. 

During its investor day in June, the company showed off its line of data center offerings and servers, including an AI accelerator, CPU, memory, and rackscale server.

CFO Akash Palkhiwala told Yahoo Finance following the event that the company expects its data center products to generate $5 billion in revenue in fiscal 2027. It also doubled its non-handset sales projections for its fiscal 2029 to $40 billion.

content_html_zh:
芯片制造商高通（QCOM）周三公布了第三季度业绩，每股收益达到预期，同时超出了收入预期。

第三季度，高通每股收益 (EPS) 为 2.21 美元，营收为 99 亿美元。 分析师预计每股收益为 2.21 美元，营收为 96 亿美元。

首席执行官克里斯蒂亚诺·阿蒙（Cristiano Amon）在一份声明中表示：“尽管内存和供应环境充满挑战，但我们第三季度的业绩反映了我们增长战略的扎实执行，季度收入达到了指导值的上限。”

“短期内，我们预计包括数据中心在内的非手机收入的同比增长将从 2026 财年的 24% 加速到 2027 财年的 60% 以上，这是我们执行增长战略的一个重要拐点。”

随着投资者评估业绩，周四盘前交易中，这家科技巨头的股价下跌近 6%。

高通正在进行广泛的多元化努力，努力减少对其手机业务的依赖，而手机业务多年来一直在放缓。

随着智能手机制造商提高价格以抵消内存和存储芯片成本上涨影响出货量，这一点变得越来越重要。

伯恩斯坦分析师史黛西·拉斯贡 (Stacy Rasgon) 周三对雅虎财经的朱莉·海曼 (Julie Hyman) 表示：“智能手机行业并不出色。”

“内存价格正在上涨，而人工智能正在消耗大量供应。 因此，它并没有给智能手机玩家留下太多的余地。 我们看到销量出现负增长，”他补充道。

CounterPoint Research 的数据显示，第二季度全球智能手机出货量同比下降 11%，是该行业 13 年来最糟糕的第二季度。

高通 CDMA 技术部门的收入（包括智能手机、物联网和汽车销售）为 85 亿美元，而预期为 82 亿美元。

尤其是手机销售额超过 51 亿美元，而预期为 49 亿美元。 汽车相关销售额达到 15 亿美元；华尔街预计该季度的收入为 14 亿美元。

高通扩大其总目标市场计划的一部分包括急剧转向人工智能数据中心领域。

在 6 月份的投资者日期间，该公司展示了其数据中心产品和服务器系列，包括人工智能加速器、CPU、内存和机架级服务器。

首席财务官 Akash Palkhiwala 在活动结束后告诉雅虎财经，该公司预计其数据中心产品将在 2027 财年产生 50 亿美元的收入。 该公司还将 2029 财年非手机销售预测翻了一番，达到 400 亿美元。
